name: 冰雪铜锅
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: full-screen painterly background art for a mobile tile-puzzle game, no interface.
Primary request: 冰雪铜锅 — outdoor snowy mountain campsite at blue hour, a fresh asymmetric environmental landscape with real distance and grounded objects. It must feel outdoors in snowy wilderness, not an indoor restaurant.
Canvas: TALL PORTRAIT 720:1520 aspect, edge-to-edge no phone frame.
Scene composition: Distant jagged snowy mountain silhouettes and a softly luminous dusky lavender-to-deep-blue sky occupy the top 22%. Snowy fir and pine forest in the distance concentrated along left/right edges, with dark navy cool silhouettes and icy blue needles. A small amber glowing tent opening is partly cropped at the UPPER-LEFT edge, only x0-17% y15-30%, firelight softly spilling across nearby snow from that corner. The camp playing ground is a LARGE FLAT pale blue smooth packed-snow/ice slab in the middle and across most of the lower area, receding into the far distant tree line at y27%. The pale icy surface is softly blue, smooth, matte with subtle low-contrast frost grain and a faint lavender reflective hue; it is clearly horizontal snowy ground in perspective, not a paper wall or a rectangular framed panel. Snowbank contours form a few rounded raised corners in lower foreground and the far left and right edges. ONE steaming traditional polished copper chimney hotpot on a short rough tree stump is at the LOWER-RIGHT edge, partly cropped, confined x83-100% and y76-97%; it casts a soft warm amber glow onto adjacent snow. NO other cooking pot anywhere. A few pine cones/branches near far bottom-left edge, minimal.
Overlay clearance: Tile cards will be placed x21-75%, y34-57%: this area must contain ONLY very pale cool-blue snowy ground with minimal texture, no object, no tree, no twig, no hard shadow, no snowflakes. Keep y74-83% broad center quiet for future tray, y91-97% central area quiet for future buttons. Do not draw any cards, tray or buttons. More detail and deep navy color should be at upper/peripheral environment, leaving pale icy center.
Style: premium handpainted casual mobile game art, rich tactile snow/ice, dimensional 3D modeled stylized pine trees and copper glow, soft painterly edges, dramatic deep navy outside vs pale frosty-blue middle and warm tent orange. Beautiful cozy winter atmosphere and high material detail, not flat vector and not photorealistic.
Absolute exclusions: no text, letters, logo, icons, UI, cards, food sprites, menu, tray or buttons. No people. NO interior room, NO roof, NO fabric swag across top, NO twin hanging lanterns, NO vases/pedestals, NO ivory paper wall, NO full wooden tabletop, NO copperpot lower-left. No falling flakes across central playing ground. One complete landscape illustration.
